title: Miscarriage 5w5d? Need advice
body:
Hi everyone,

I’m hoping to hear from anyone who’s been through something similar. This has been such an emotional rollercoaster, and I feel like I’m stuck in limbo.

I recently found out I was pregnant. At around 5 weeks 3 days, I started spotting brown on a Monday and by Wednesday night I started seeing red blood when I wiped only. Next morning I woke up with my shorts pretty much soaked in dark red blood went straight to the ER. It lasted about 12–18 hours—like a period, but I haven’t passed any clots. After that, the bleeding tapered off to mostly light spotting that’s dark red or brown (mostly brown when I wipe only). The liners I’ve been using barely have any spotting on them. I haven’t had any pain at all, just fatigue similar to early pregnancy.

At the ER, the doctors said “sorry for your loss” BUT also told me they couldn’t locate a pregnancy anywhere. My hCG levels were:
        •        Monday: 725
        •        Thursday(at the ER):2,665

The ER paperwork said they couldn’t confirm if it was an ectopic pregnancy, a very early miscarriage, or something else. An ultrasound didn’t show a sac in my uterus, but they did see cysts on my ovaries. They said if hCG keeps rising, ectopic is still a possibility.

Since then, my bleeding has mostly stopped—just occasional spotting. No pain, I haven’t noticed any cramps. I’m going back tomorrow to repeat labs and hopefully get answers.

It’s so confusing because my hCG went up quite a lot, and I still feel pregnant. Part of me wonders if this is just how a chemical pregnancy looks.

Has anyone experienced something similar—bleeding early on with rising hCG, no clots, and no sac visible on ultrasound? Did it turn out to be ectopic, a miscarriage, or a viable pregnancy? I would really appreciate hearing any stories.

Thank you for reading. This is so hard to process, and I feel like I’m clinging to any bit of hope or clarity.

Abuse.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Abuse.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

Medical.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Medical.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

Mental Health.title: Struggling to feel excited in first trimester
Mental Health.body:
TW: talk of infant death and miscarriage. 

I (f21) am expecting my first baby with my husband (m23). I really want to be happy and excited and hopeful, but ever since I was a little girl and I found out about miscarriage/stillbirth, I’ve had such a deep fear of pregnancy/child loss. 

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I just really don’t want to miscarry while he’s away. I really don’t want to miscarry at all. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. I feel like I’ll never be able to breathe again, even if the baby ends up being born how am I going to deal with the anxiety of SIDS or car accidents or fucking lightning striking my child. How do moms do this??

I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

Pregnancy.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Pregnancy.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

Abuse.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Abuse.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

He was black out drunk (I work at a pub) and the way it was handled by my work wasn’t very professional. He was kicked out and told he wasn’t allowed to come back in to pay his tab without talking to my boss or my male coworker first since I made it clear I did not want to have contact with him.

He’s been very drunk/overserved numerous times before this incident, and now dealing with that, i don’t want to deal with what could happen if he got blacked out drunk again (if he didn’t remember what he did, he could just as well do it again). But now since he’s just allowed back I’m not sure what legal action I could take if i chose to do that. What would be the options I could take? Cause honestly my biggest option is just quitting my job and working at a different place since it’s not the first sexual harassment incident I’ve gone through and it’s definitely not the last, and it’s clear my boss can’t handle dealing with situations properly.

Medical.title: Struggling to feel excited in first trimester
Medical.body:
TW: talk of infant death and miscarriage. 

I (f21) am expecting my first baby with my husband (m23). I really want to be happy and excited and hopeful, but ever since I was a little girl and I found out about miscarriage/stillbirth, I’ve had such a deep fear of pregnancy/child loss. 

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I just really don’t want to miscarry while he’s away. I really don’t want to miscarry at all. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. I feel like I’ll never be able to breathe again, even if the baby ends up being born how am I going to deal with the anxiety of SIDS or car accidents or fucking lightning striking my child. How do moms do this??

Discrimination.title: Why does society expectations about having one of each genders mess with us?
Discrimination.body:
I know there are people out there who say they generally don’t care what genders their babies are. I wish I was one of those people. First and foremost, of course I just want happy and healthy children and I know whatever I get I will love them! Yes, we all know that there are people out there who struggle with conceiving or who have a bad experience in having children. I get that! 
We have had a miscarriage in between having our children and it was a hard experience to go through. I feel society constantly makes you feel like having one of each is the ultimate dream. We are always reminded by these expectations! I know I cannot control the gender, but I just wish I didn’t feel I wasn’t missing out on not having a daughter. When I think deeply about why I want a daughter, it’s basically because I get caught up worrying about what other people say about our family or them placing their pity over us for having only boys. I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. How do moms do this??

Abuse.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Abuse.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

Aggression.body:
About three/four weeks ago I went through an incident of sexual harassment/assault at work from a customer. He was black out drunk (I work at a pub) and the way it was handled by my work wasn’t very professional. He was kicked out and told he wasn’t allowed to come back in to pay his tab without talking to my boss or my male coworker first since I made it clear I did not want to have contact with him. 

Well my boss allowed him to come into work yesterday without informing me. And not just to pay his tab, he was allowed to stay and drink. Thankfully I had someone else covering the opening part of my shift but was planning on coming in earlier to help with the bar since there was an event so I knew the restaurant was super busy. The statie told me that the guy admits he doesn’t remember what happened but takes full accountability for it and that he wants to apologize to me in person but on my terms. My boss also has talked about him coming in to apologize and I’ve expressed very clearly before that I don’t want to talk to him or hear an “I’m sorry for sexually assaulting you” apology, even if he has owned up to what happened. 

I just wanted to not have him in when I’m working or still be there when I’m into work. He’s been very drunk/overserved numerous times before this incident, and now dealing with that, i don’t want to deal with what could happen if he got blacked out drunk again (if he didn’t remember what he did, he could just as well do it again). But now since he’s just allowed back I’m not sure what legal action I could take if i chose to do that. What would be the options I could take? Cause honestly my biggest option is just quitting my job and working at a different place since it’s not the first sexual harassment incident I’ve gone through and it’s definitely not the last, and it’s clear my boss can’t handle dealing with situations properly.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.body:
Hello eveyone,
I’m new here and I’m happy to try and find answers. I’ve had four miscarriages. My fourth one happened today. All my miscarriages ended between 4-8 weeks. I’m so heartbroken and devastated. I don’t even know if I want to get pregnant again. I want to find answers and get some testing done. I’ve done a lot of testing the past year:
-me and my partner did genetic testing
-husband did semen test
-sis came back normal
-vitmain d normal 
-thyroid is normal
-I did a recurrent miscarriage panel
-my white blood cells are at a 4 
-i did vaginal biopsy. I had chronic endometritis  i took antibiotics antibiotics and was cleanered  

There’s some other testing that I did. When I got pregnant with my fourth pregnancy I took baby aspirin.progesterone twice,vitmain d and prenatal vitmain. In this pregnancy my hcg was rising but not doubling after 4 weeks. My tsh would go up and down. For an example once it was 1.98 and then weeks later it was 2.59. Same goes for my white blood cell it kept going up then suddenly dropped this week and now it’s back up. 

What type of testing should I do moving forwarding. I want recommendations. I’m lost 😔

Discrimination.title: Why does society expectations about having one of each genders mess with us?
Discrimination.body:
I know there are people out there who say they generally don’t care what genders their babies are. I wish I was one of those people. First and foremost, of course I just want happy and healthy children and I know whatever I get I will love them! Yes, we all know that there are people out there who struggle with conceiving or who have a bad experience in having children. I get that! 
We have had a miscarriage in between having our children and it was a hard experience to go through. I feel society constantly makes you feel like having one of each is the ultimate dream. We are always reminded by these expectations! I know I cannot control the gender, but I just wish I didn’t feel I wasn’t missing out on not having a daughter. When I think deeply about why I want a daughter, it’s basically because I get caught up worrying about what other people say about our family or them placing their pity over us for having only boys. I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

Pregnancy.body:
TW: talk of infant death and miscarriage. 

I (f21) am expecting my first baby with my husband (m23). I really want to be happy and excited and hopeful, but ever since I was a little girl and I found out about miscarriage/stillbirth, I’ve had such a deep fear of pregnancy/child loss. 

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I just really don’t want to miscarry while he’s away. I really don’t want to miscarry at all. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. I feel like I’ll never be able to breathe again, even if the baby ends up being born how am I going to deal with the anxiety of SIDS or car accidents or fucking lightning striking my child. How do moms do this??

Pregnancy.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Pregnancy.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

title: Natural Miscarriage - Timeline so far
body:
I found out last Saturday 21st (at 8 weeks) that baby was measuring 6w1d without a heartbeat. I had experienced very pale brown spotting for a day or so prior. Wednesday 25th I had to have a similar scan with NHS and no further development was seen. The gynaecologist warned me they would see me again in a week but I may start to miscarry naturally in the interim.
This Friday (27th) during the day, I started bleeding and cramping which intensified into the evening and overnight I begun passing golf ball sized clots. 
Continued passing clots through Saturday (28th) and with unrelenting cramping and starting to feel faint I called the EPU who advised me to come to A&E for a check up. 
On arrival at A&E I blacked out during triage and was given fluids and pain relief for the continued cramping. The gynaecologist also came and examined me and said they didn't think my cervix was 'fully open' yet and therefore it was likely the sac was still to pass. 
I was kept in overnight for monitoring where the cramps continued to intensify. 
I have, however, had reduced bleeding and have not passed any more large clots/pregnancy tissue that I'm aware of since yesterday evening. 
As of this evening, the cramping has now also significantly lessened. (Though this may be down to the prescribed painkillers).

Apologies for the long post but I am just cautious if the reduction in bleeding/clots/cramping may mean this is winding down and I am concerned if the bleeding internal exam was correct and I haven't passed the sac yet. 

I have a follow up scan Wednesday to confirm if anything remains but wondered if anyone else had experienced similar or had a subsidence in miscarriage symptoms with a resumption in the days later?

Abuse.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Abuse.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

Medical.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Medical.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Medical.title: Recurring miscarriages 😞😔
Medical.body:
Hello eveyone,
I’m new here and I’m happy to try and find answers. I’ve had four miscarriages. My fourth one happened today. All my miscarriages ended between 4-8 weeks. I’m so heartbroken and devastated. I don’t even know if I want to get pregnant again. I want to find answers and get some testing done. I’ve done a lot of testing the past year:
-me and my partner did genetic testing
-husband did semen test
-sis came back normal
-vitmain d normal 
-thyroid is normal
-I did a recurrent miscarriage panel
-my white blood cells are at a 4 
-i did vaginal biopsy. I had chronic endometritis  i took antibiotics antibiotics and was cleanered  

There’s some other testing that I did. When I got pregnant with my fourth pregnancy I took baby aspirin.progesterone twice,vitmain d and prenatal vitmain. In this pregnancy my hcg was rising but not doubling after 4 weeks. My tsh would go up and down. For an example once it was 1.98 and then weeks later it was 2.59. Same goes for my white blood cell it kept going up then suddenly dropped this week and now it’s back up. 

What type of testing should I do moving forwarding. I want recommendations. I’m lost 😔

Discrimination.title: Why does society expectations about having one of each genders mess with us?

I know there are people out there who say they generally don’t care what genders their babies are. I wish I was one of those people. First and foremost, of course I just want happy and healthy children and I know whatever I get I will love them! Yes, we all know that there are people out there who struggle with conceiving or who have a bad experience in having children. I get that! 
We have had a miscarriage in between having our children and it was a hard experience to go through. I feel society constantly makes you feel like having one of each is the ultimate dream. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

title: MMC, D&C, then Chemical Pregnancy?
body:
I found out in March - when I was supposed to be 11 weeks pregnant - that it was fetal demise and development stopped around 8 weeks. 
I thought I miscarried naturally by the amount of bleeding/cramping I experienced immediately after. However, in May I began having intense bleeding and cramping again. Surprise! Ultrasound showed the fetal tissue fully retained. After a month of pain and bleeding, I finally had a D&C. Bled for a week after that.. had 5 days of no bleeding and finally feeling better.. and BOOM, my first period showed up with a vengeance. 
After a rough 9 day period.. I think I had a normal cycle. However, I definitely had “TTC fatigue” after the 6 month long failed pregnancy and didn’t track things closely. 
Last week, as my period due date drew near, I started having nausea after my coffee… took an early detection test- faint positive. Took a second one the next day.. still faint, but still positive. 
Then that night, I started having some spotting, which turned into A LOT of tissue, then into raging bleeding. 
Is this just a chemical pregnancy? Was my uterine lining still too unstable after the D&C? Could something be wrong inside? 
I have an appointment next week for an ultrasound, but my doctors office gave me zero info over the phone. 
Feeling pretty defeated and devastated at the thought of 2 miscarriages back to back. 

Anyone else experience a chemical pregnancy immediately after a D&C?

Abuse.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Abuse.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

Medical.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Medical.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

Mental Health.title: Struggling to feel excited in first trimester
Mental Health.body:
TW: talk of infant death and miscarriage. 

I (f21) am expecting my first baby with my husband (m23). I really want to be happy and excited and hopeful, but ever since I was a little girl and I found out about miscarriage/stillbirth, I’ve had such a deep fear of pregnancy/child loss. 

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I just really don’t want to miscarry while he’s away. I really don’t want to miscarry at all. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. I feel like I’ll never be able to breathe again, even if the baby ends up being born how am I going to deal with the anxiety of SIDS or car accidents or fucking lightning striking my child. How do moms do this??

So now I’m panicked because I did a bunch of things that probably weren’t great. I got a tooth infection and took ibuprofen like candy for 5 days. I did at least let the doctor know that we were ttc so he prescribed pregnancy safe antibiotics just in case. I also couldn’t eat anything but mushy foods for almost a week. So my diet has been terrible. And I quit taking my metformin (prescribed for PCOS) while on the antibiotics because it had terrible gastrointestinal side effects. 

So now I’m feeling guilty as crap and like I might have just ruined our second chance. I’m obviously calling my ob in the morning to get a blood test and discuss these things ASAP. But is this all as bad as I’m thinking it is? Give it to me straight.

Discrimination.title: Why does society expectations about having one of each genders mess with us?
Discrimination.body:
I know there are people out there who say they generally don’t care what genders their babies are. I wish I was one of those people. First and foremost, of course I just want happy and healthy children and I know whatever I get I will love them! Yes, we all know that there are people out there who struggle with conceiving or who have a bad experience in having children. I get that! 
We have had a miscarriage in between having our children and it was a hard experience to go through. I feel society constantly makes you feel like having one of each is the ultimate dream. We are always reminded by these expectations! I know I cannot control the gender, but I just wish I didn’t feel I wasn’t missing out on not having a daughter. When I think deeply about why I want a daughter, it’s basically because I get caught up worrying about what other people say about our family or them placing their pity over us for having only boys. I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

title: Someone said congratulations
body:
Someone congratulated me and I asked for what? And they said they heard from my friend that I was pregnant.  Guess my friend forgot to let them know I miscarried. I had to be the one to say it.

"I actually miscarried."

Awkward. 

They apologized, I said it was okay. I always tell people it's okay. 

Because what else are you supposed to say? 

I cried a little and then sucked it up because we were on our way to another friend's house. 

His wife is having a baby 1 week after mine was supposed to be due. Announced to us a month ago when we had been planning to but we had the miscarriage news instead.

I guess he was being thoughtful. He asked if I was pregnant before starting to vape.

"No, I miscarried last month."

Dude we told you.  But thanks for making me say it out loud. I mean if you forgot okay,  but I'm also drinking the alcohol you bought, in front of you.  

"Oh, yea, how are you doing?"

"I'm okay."

Both in the same fucking day.

I'm not okay.

If you're wondering, the way I found out was my (ex) husband came to our house. He moved out, but came back to apologize and promised to tell me everything and gave me his phone for proof. He told me who all knew, two of his friends and her.

Abuse.title: Was this sexual harassment? I don’t want to call it something it’s not
Abuse.body: A few months back, a guy friend of mine texted me. I could tell he liked me but the feeling was not mutual so whenever I saw him, I made it abundantly clear that I really liked/was speaking to another guy (who we both know.) Anyway, he texted me and told me he was ‘touch starved’ and proceeded to say ‘i’m not going to ask you for sex because you’re probably saving yourself for X (the guy I liked), but if you want to platonically make out that would be great’ Upon receiving these texts I was completely baffled as i’d made it clear I was into another guy. I rejected him and told him things had progressed between me and the guy and we were now sleeping together (I genuinely don’t understand how he could POSSIBLY think i’d say yes). He then replied with something along the lines of ‘No problem, but the fact you managed to pull X is impressive.’ This annoyed me as he implied I was punching above my weight. I saw him a few weeks after he texted me and he was awkward around me for the entire night, sheepishly saying ‘sorry for asking you to shag me’ (implying that he did want to do more than make out) when we were alone together. He was awkward around me in school (we were in the same friend group.) A few months after the text, our friend group were all out together to get drunk in a field (socially distanced). We were walking in twos bc of covid restrictions and I ended up getting stuck walking with him. He was on the side of the pavement closest to the road whilst I was on his other side. At one point he said ‘you’re too drunk you’re going to fall into the road’ and tried to put his arm around me. I was completely sober and was not about to do that (I wasn’t even near the road). I pushed him off and told him to get off me, as I felt incredibly uncomfortable around him at this point. I ended up leaving early because he kept sitting too close to me. I thought we were on okay terms, but he unfollowed me on social media today. Here is my question- does this count as sexual harassment? I only ask as one of my friends was talking about him (I told her what happened) and said that he sexually harassed me. But I don’t know if it necessarily is harassment. He certainly made me feel uncomfortable both times, but when he texted me but he didn’t make any attempt to try and persuade me to say yes after I rejected him. In regards to him trying to put his arm around me, this could have been seen as just a friendly gesture, but it made me uncomfortable because he knew I’m still romantically involved with X and I wasn’t even drunk. But then again, does trying to put your arm around someone count? I’m still hurt at the fact he tried to make our friendship sexual, as he was a good friend to me for a while. So- was this a case of sexual harassment or merely me putting him deep in the friendzoned?

Sexual.title: Was it really assault or am I just crazy?
Sexual.body:
Gonna keep this as short as possible but in February a guy I had been hanging out with came over and we were making out and he asked what else I wanted to do, but I told him I was depressed and didn’t really want to do anything else; he said okay and didn’t bring it back up again for a little while until he tried to move my hand onto his crotch; i said no again. he dropped it for a bit until he was pushing himself against me while i was in his lap, and i can’t remember what he said but i know i told him i didn’t want to do anything again. then he was on top of/in front of me(we were on a couch. i don’t sit on that side of the couch anymore) and he slid his hand up my leg and into my shorts. And i didn’t stop him. I don’t know why i didn’t stop him. i mean part of me was scared of how he’d react if i said no again because i barely knew him, but i also didn’t feel like fighting it anymore because i knew he’d keep asking. i didn’t let him keep going, like i pushed his hand out of my pants and told him that he didn’t have to do that, i just gave him a handjob and he left. 

i’ve been told by friends, by my mom and my sisters, i’ve been told by a therapist and someone else who worked at a psych ward i was in that it was assault but i can’t stop thinking that maybe i did want it? i mean if i didn’t want it why would i let it happen? i don’t know. i just feel like it was my fault, like i should have kicked him out the second time he tried or i should’ve kept saying no and it wouldn’t have happened. i don’t know. i just think i would’ve done more if i really didn’t want it to happen

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Struggling to feel excited in first trimester
Medical.body:
TW: talk of infant death and miscarriage. 

I (f21) am expecting my first baby with my husband (m23). I really want to be happy and excited and hopeful, but ever since I was a little girl and I found out about miscarriage/stillbirth, I’ve had such a deep fear of pregnancy/child loss. 

Lmp date was 4/20/2025, but at our first ultrasound when I should have been almost 9 weeks, baby was measuring at 6w 5d and they found a large (more than 50% the size of the sac) SCH adjacent to the gestational sac. There was no real reason or explanation for either thing and I feel like I was sent home to either miscarry or not until our next appointment on July 17th where I should be 10.5 weeks. Our fetus is confirmed IUP and viable with a good heartbeat. 

I know I should try to hold on to the indescribable joy of hearing our child’s heartbeat for the first time, but seeing the massive pocket of blood directly afterwards and being told we are measuring 2.5 weeks behind has unfortunately overshadowed that beautiful moment and made me feel like I can’t be happy or excited. 

With the lack of information of course fell into a Google search hole and from what I can tell, my risk of pregnancy loss or stillbirth has gone up quite significantly. Everytime the nausea eases up or my boobs feel slightly less sore I’m horrified that my baby is just dead. 

I just don’t know how to be happy or excited when the risk of loss is so great. I keep trying to remind myself that I am pregnant today and that’s all that matters. I’ve greatly increased my vitamin c, d and A Lipaic acid intake within my diet to help the sch heal and reabsorb and so far at 8w 2d I have not had any bleeding or spotting. I’m resting as much as I can and I’ve put myself on pelvic rest to try to help my body and hopefully not bleed. 

Idk. I just feel like I’m doing all I can but I can’t help but feel soooo guilty for how negative I’m feeling. My family keeps saying to just manifest good things and put good vibes out there, so I can’t help but feel like if I do lose the baby it’ll be because of my inability to be happy and hopeful all the time. 

Through all of this, my husband has been my absolute rock and safe space. He has lit up this experience so much and kept me as positive and happy as possible, but he’s on a work trip this week and I’m just here alone with the dogs trying to take care of all of us all while scrutinizing every tiny change in cramping and discharge and just waiting for something awful to happen. I just really don’t want to miscarry while he’s away. I really don’t want to miscarry at all. I understand that in the human experience it is a negative thing to wish to a positive experience, and a positive thing to embrace a negative experience, but how the fuck do I embrace this awful feeling. I feel like I’ll never be able to breathe again, even if the baby ends up being born how am I going to deal with the anxiety of SIDS or car accidents or fucking lightning striking my child. How do moms do this??

Medical.title: Thought we were out this month. Just popped a positive and now I’m panicked. How bad is it?
Medical.body:
We’ve been trying for almost two years with only a miscarriage to show for it. This month lh didn’t spike nearly as high as normal so I felt pretty sure it wasn’t going to be our time this month. Well I just took a test and got a positive. Probably only like 10-12 dpo, but it was definitely positive. 

So now I’m panicked because I did a bunch of things that probably weren’t great. I got a tooth infection and took ibuprofen like candy for 5 days. I did at least let the doctor know that we were ttc so he prescribed pregnancy safe antibiotics just in case. I also couldn’t eat anything but mushy foods for almost a week. So my diet has been terrible. And I quit taking my metformin (prescribed for PCOS) while on the antibiotics because it had terrible gastrointestinal side effects. 

So now I’m feeling guilty as crap and like I might have just ruined our second chance. I’m obviously calling my ob in the morning to get a blood test and discuss these things ASAP. But is this all as bad as I’m thinking it is? Give it to me straight.

Mental Health.title: Am I over reacting to my family’s reaction?
Mental Health.body:
We happened to be out of state at my parents house when I miscarried. My parents knew I was pregnant and I told them I was bleeding and cramping and my husband and I were going to the ER. My mom is a doctor and works at that hospital and did not go with us. Which I get, maybe she was trying to give us our privacy. But what really gets me is their reaction in the aftermath since then. I received a hug and “sorry you had a bad day” and “don’t let this consume you” since my miscarriage and that’s it. Neither of my parents or brother who was also there for this have reached out to me to even say, “I’m sorry for your loss” or “How are you?” Like wtffff

Maybe they’re trying to give me space, but it has really shown me my family’s true colors. I could have bled out and instead they didn’t even ask what the ER doctor said or anything. Just asked if we wanted to come over to eat and we had dinner over there like nothing even happened. Like I wasn’t activity miscarrying their only grandchild and our first pregnancy. As we flew home my mother told my husband to, “make sure she doesn’t get depressed” like wtf does that even mean?!!

😪 just had to get that out there. Luckily my MIL and best friend have been amazing during this time, but just sucks when your own family can’t even be there for you. 

I always worried about what kind of grandma my mom would be and now I know she’s going to be the kind who shows up to just hold baby and buy you random baby crap you don’t need.

Discrimination.title: I have been inappropriately touched by women. How do I say ni when this happens?
Discrimination.body:
I need an advice on this matter. I (m) have been touched by several females in my life. For example, there was this girl in college I was good friends with. One day, out of blue, she looked at my chest and touched it, saying, "Wow, you have nice packs!" I was confounded and didn't know even what to say right away. But I thought it would only be fair if I could do the same, so I tried grab her boob (not roughly). She retracted and told me that it was not the same.

Or there is this another girl who pinched my nipple for making a sarcastic joke. I mean, what the heck?? Do people think men's nipples are not as sensitive as women's?? Or that men too would feel insulted by being treated that way?

These two are just few examples of many. There have been incidents where an older woman touched my butt with a compliment, but I felt pressured to put on a mask just because I'm a guy. They seemed to normalize it without even being conscious of the fact that what they did to me would be considered sexual harassment. It took me years even for me to come to realize this. I was even once told to take these actions as compliment.

Though I don't think I need to see a counselor or amything, I still feel a bit insulted by actions. Whenever I see these women sometimes, I can't really be at ease. Is this something usual that happen to other guys too? How do I address this to women who do this?

Discrimination.title: Why does society expectations about having one of each genders mess with us?
Discrimination.body:
I know there are people out there who say they generally don’t care what genders their babies are. I wish I was one of those people. First and foremost, of course I just want happy and healthy children and I know whatever I get I will love them! Yes, we all know that there are people out there who struggle with conceiving or who have a bad experience in having children. I get that! 
We have had a miscarriage in between having our children and it was a hard experience to go through. I feel society constantly makes you feel like having one of each is the ultimate dream. We are always reminded by these expectations! I know I cannot control the gender, but I just wish I didn’t feel I wasn’t missing out on not having a daughter. When I think deeply about why I want a daughter, it’s basically because I get caught up worrying about what other people say about our family or them placing their pity over us for having only boys. I hate the feeling! I love my boys, but wish I had the experience of parenting both genders as well as having my boys. I would not have another one just to try for a girl. I would only have another knowing I am 100% content about having another boy. I feel when my parents or in laws talk about it you can sense their disappointment and it makes me feel sad. Anyone else know what I mean? Can you connect to this post? If so, talk me through how you feel now and how you overcame these annoying feelings.

Discrimination.title: Legal Action Advice
Discrimination.body:
About three/four weeks ago I went through an incident of sexual harassment/assault at work from a customer. He was black out drunk (I work at a pub) and the way it was handled by my work wasn’t very professional. He was kicked out and told he wasn’t allowed to come back in to pay his tab without talking to my boss or my male coworker first since I made it clear I did not want to have contact with him. 

Well my boss allowed him to come into work yesterday without informing me. And not just to pay his tab, he was allowed to stay and drink. Thankfully I had someone else covering the opening part of my shift but was planning on coming in earlier to help with the bar since there was an event so I knew the restaurant was super busy. I was notified by my male coworker that he showed up so I had to wait till he was gone to come in for my shift. 

One of my regulars is a state trooper and he pulled me aside to tell me that from a professional view, I could take it further if the incident made me this uncomfortable (he wasn’t informed much on what happened). I didn’t have intent to pursue anything legal cause I thought he’d be barred on the days i work, but now I’m not sure what I want to do. 

The statie told me that the guy admits he doesn’t remember what happened but takes full accountability for it and that he wants to apologize to me in person but on my terms. My boss also has talked about him coming in to apologize and I’ve expressed very clearly before that I don’t want to talk to him or hear an “I’m sorry for sexually assaulting you” apology, even if he has owned up to what happened. 

I just wanted to not have him in when I’m working or still be there when I’m into work. He’s been very drunk/overserved numerous times before this incident, and now dealing with that, i don’t want to deal with what could happen if he got blacked out drunk again (if he didn’t remember what he did, he could just as well do it again). But now since he’s just allowed back I’m not sure what legal action I could take if i chose to do that. What would be the options I could take? Cause honestly my biggest option is just quitting my job and working at a different place since it’s not the first sexual harassment incident I’ve gone through and it’s definitely not the last, and it’s clear my boss can’t handle dealing with situations properly.

body:
Found out at 10DPO, line profession was steady and test and control were same colour on day of missed period. 

Went to ED at 5+1 cramping and light bleeding. Bedside ultrasound confirmed pregnancy in uterus. 1st blood results were “lost” and 2nd were 17,000. 

Early pregnancy unit contacted today to say first results 1.5 hours before were 19,000 so HCG dropped in 1.5 hours so likely non viable.

Certain it’s a miscarriage but unsure as to how long the pain and cramping and bleeding could go on for? Hospital can/will intervene at my request after the next blood draw but google essentially says could be weeks or may not happen. Just thinking out loud.. processing.
