Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Pregnancy.title: Always Worried I Was Not Meant To Be Born
Pregnancy.body:
Before I was born my parents had gone through two other pregnancies. One of them resulted in my sister, the other tragically ended in a late miscarriage. I was conceived of about a year later and I am nearly certain I was a consolation child for my mother. I do not think my dad wanted me and I think my mom has a deep disappointment over well, me. 



I don't say this without reason. The first thing that comes to mind is that my dad has always hated me and I do mean always. For example my earliest memory of him is a mocking monologue of how I described a television show, the disgust was dripping from his tone. My mom seemed more subtly disgusted by me but it was certainly there. The overcompensated declarations of affection, the perceivable lack of joy in her eyes when around me, and the inverse with my sister all point to that being the case. There's much more I could add but it would be pedantic. I'm confident in how I have judged the situation, but confidence means little when I feel terrible about the whole thing.

  
There's no resentment for how my family feels about me in my heart, but there is a hole where something is missing. The root of that I can only imagine is that the strands of fate simply never intended for it to be filled. Point being I don't think I should have been born nor that I was meant to be born. Perhaps if I was not my consciousness would have ended up somewhere else that was better but who can say. I can say that I wish my parents' other child had been born and that I was not. 



I don't find comfort in thinking my existence is the worse of two options, predictably it fills me with dread. Like there was a cosmic mistake or misdeed when I came to exist as I do now and that it was in some way my fault. Did I take a wrong turn before I could even know it? Should I have died well before now? Would my mom feel better if I did? I don't know, but I suspect those to be true more often than not.

  
I don't want to die, but I do wish I had never existed. I'm not sure I want to change that feeling either so would something like therapy even work?

Pregnancy.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Pregnancy.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Medical.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

Pregnancy.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Pregnancy.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

title: Was I the victim or was she? I have severe doubts and I have guilt over the incident.
body:
Let me preface this by saying that I was a dumb, horny 15 year old. A dumb horny 15 year old who had no idea how alcohol worked.

This whole situation happened a very, very long time ago and I wasn't able to remember massive details that happened in my original post to the subreddit about it. Now after thinking about it harder, I am able to remember the full story. [Here's my original post if you want to read it, but it leaves out key details of the story.](https://www.reddit.com/r/MenGetRapedToo/comments/nev1c9/was_this_coercion/)

This story starts off with me doing a horrible thing.

I asked my girlfriend if I could have phone sex with her, while she was drunk. She agreed to it.

But then I realized the night before, she said she was uncomfortable with phone sex. I didn't want to harm her, so I did the responsible thing; and broke off the interaction **before it could even begin** by telling her I was not comfortable having sexual interactions with her while she was drunk and I wanted her to wait till she was sober to make her decision on whether or not she wanted the interaction.

A long while later she tells me she isn't drunk, I do phone sex with her because I believed that she was actually sober, and she didn't sound drunk at all when I joined the call, and I trusted her not to deceive me since I was in a relationship with her. Then a week or so later she confesses that she was actually drunk the whole time.

I get really uneasy about the whole situation, I get really frustrated and I start feeling a massive amount of guilt.

I feel violated in a way because I was made to do something that I would've been normally uncomfortable with and I would've normally not consented to, but at the same time it just entirely feels like it's all my fault.

This whole situation is far, far too complex for me to judge myself on myself. Please give me your thoughts. Please also don't go too hard on me, because as of right now I regret everything that happened.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

title: Is this sexual harassment? TW: childhood abuse
body:
This is a very complicated situation. I am a girl of 18 years old, and about a month ago my sister (16) told my mum that my dad sexually abused her for many years. Social work became involved and my dad has been removed from the family home. My sister is safe from him now, though she does not wish to press charges. 

I’ve been subject to years of emotional and misogynistic abuse from my dad. Social work have been involved on many occasions. But I’ve been attending counselling recently and I’ve really been thinking about some of the things my dad did and said to me when he still lived in my house and wondering if they were sexual harassment or assault?: 

When I was 12 or 13, my dad used to comment on my changing body no matter how hard I tried to conceal it. He would call me ‘nubile’ and ‘curvaceous’. I was deeply uncomfortable with him saying these things and I told him to stop, but he never did. 

He used to ‘accidentally’ walk in when I was bathing or showering (our locks are easily undone from the outside) when I was sure I had locked the door, and then later comment on ‘how developed’ I was. 

I didn’t know what to call the discomfort I felt about his actions when I was younger because I didn’t have the concept of sexual abuse or harassment. But now that I am a bit older, I feel differently. 

What do you think: does this qualify as sexual harassment?

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
Medical.body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Pregnancy.title: I feel like my boyfriend’s “replacement”. I feel guilty for being with him
Pregnancy.body:
We haven’t been dating very long, almost 6 months now. I didn’t really want to start dating him, it was just kind of how it played out. Not gonna go into too much detail, but the relationship definitely feels rooted in sex. 

 He has been *extremely* insistent on getting married and having a kid someday (I am 21M and he is 26M), and I wasn’t sure why. I explained to him that I do NOT want to get married, but might be open to kids in the future… like way in the future, maybe a decade from now. I’ve also explained that if we do decide to have a kid, I want to be comfortable financially, have an actual house with a small yard, and want to get my mental health issues sorted out. 

 Since our first few days being officially together, he’s always bringing up the desire to have kids… and recently, I feel like I know why. We started talking about previous relationship experiences, and he opened up about how in his last relationship, he had a fiancée who got pregnant with his kid. She ended up having a miscarriage, and they later broke up. Not sure how much later and if the miscarriage was part of the reason, but these are all hard things for him to go through. 

 Lately, however, I came to a realization. I think the reason that he’s SO insistent on getting married and having kids is because he wants to pick up where he left off on his last relationship. I understand that he’s a bit older and wants to settle down, but I am nowhere near ready for that… nor do I want to get married. At all. I have explained that multiple times, and he still is VERY insistent on marriage and children. 

 We don’t live close enough to each other to even be able to care for a child together. He lives about 2 hours away from me, so he’s been insisting we move in together. All of this is happening really fast, and I’m not sure how to feel about it all. I feel guilty for it, I guess. I feel like I’m inadvertently leading him on, but at the same time, I have explained multiple times in detail WHY I do not want to do these things. 

 Because our relationship started after becoming intimate with each other, I have also started to feel as if that’s the only thing we have going for each other, and I feel really bad about it. We didn’t get to know each other very well before we started dating, and because of that, we have little to no overlapping interests. I will add that I would’ve waited at least another month before we started dating, but again, he was extremely insistent on dating.

 I feel really bad about it all. I really can’t see a future with him, especially because I cannot willfully give him the future he wants, and so I feel like I’m inadvertently leading him on. I don’t even know how to begin discussing this with him. He’s not the overly sensitive type, but I feel like he’d crumble to pieces if I started to even imply that we won’t be together in the future. I know I should just man up and tell him these things, but I don’t even know where to begin. He crosses my boundaries a lot, annoys me constantly, always pushes my buttons like a toddler or young child would… and I just cannot see myself doing this long-term. I feel so horrible about it. Part of me wants to just tell him to his face that if he wants to get married and have kids so soon, he needs to find somebody else… but I feel that’s too harsh, even if that’s the truth. 

 I am also worried that he might retaliate physically if I tell him. He told me he got into a “stupid domestic violence” situation and had to go to court over it. He says he only acted in self defense, but I have no idea, I’ve only got his word to go with. He’s also a bit bigger than I am, and much stronger, so I worry about how things would go if he didn’t take it well.

 I know I’m prolonging the inevitable by continuing to be with him, and I know the longer this goes on, the more it’ll hurt him, but I’m just at a loss. He always makes sure to tell me what a good boyfriend I am, and I know deep down that I am not. Our relationship started while I was having a manic episode. I don’t think I would’ve done any of that had I been in a normal state of mind, and I always feel so disgusted with myself when he mentions how the first date went down, because I didn’t mean for it to go that way. 

 I just feel horrible.


TLDR: Boyfriend of nearly 6 months insists on getting married and having kids, but our relationship started during my manic episode and I don’t think I can keep doing this, and I feel horrible about it.

title: Something nearly happened to me last night and I can't stop thinking about it m21
body:
A little bit of backstory, I'm a 21 year old straight male about 6'1 and fairly slim. I've been hit on a fair amount before by gay men and it's never bothered me. I'm always polite about it but make it very clear that I'm not interested, and it's never been a problem before.   


My friend that I've known for years messages me on Snapchat asking me to come round to get high and drink. He's like 6'4 and a fairly large bloke. I say yeah and was at his house in 30 minutes. The room we were in was very small, smaller than a walk in closet, and when we were both sitting at his desk we were almost touching. I was there for probably 20 minutes before he started making 'jokes'. He scruffed up my hair and ran his hand down the side of my face and said he was going to kiss me. I was uncomfortable so I just said no and pulled back. He tells me he was only joking and I believed him. But apart from that things were fine and chill until we had smoked the first joint.

Just stealing little glances between my legs and pushing his legs up against mine. At the time I told myself I was just high and it was fine. So I went to order some food but my phone died so I had to plug it in. The plug didn't reach from under the desk so I had to hold it down at knee level so the charger didn't come out. I pick what I wanted and ask him what he wants, instead of telling me he takes the phone out of my hand and leans against me so he's like propped up on my thigh.   
He keeps taking little looks at me and asking me 'is this alright' 'is this alright', I know I should have just said I was uncomfortable but I didn't, but I think I had made it more than clear that I wasn't interested. I grab my phone off of him and move back, and he must have gotten the message because he backs off and swivels his chair around so he's pretty much as far away from me as he can be.   


Not even 10 minutes later, the first red flag I actually put stock into.   
He asks me if I want to fuck him. 

I said no, 

'but why though'

Guy sounded upset/angry, I wanted to believe he was joking so i had said something like 'oh now I know why you brought me here'

'Yeah im gonna rape you whilst you sleep'  


I didn't know what to do. I thought I was gonna have a fucking panic attack, I had already agreed to stay the night and didn't see any easy way of leaving.   
Anyway the food arrives and things went back to normal for a little bit, I zoned out, kinda just let the weed carry me off for a while.   
But when we're done eating his jokes started to become more and more deprived, more jokes about rape and other fucked up stuff I don't want to post here. His fists are clenched and he seems anxious about something, and he just keep looking over at me. (definitely not at my face)

The last red flag was that it had started raining. The guy has a window in his ceiling so you have to stand up and stretch with this pole to close the window. He says that I should do it so i get the pole stand up and stretch. I probably should have realised this was a bad idea cus the guy puts his fucking hands around me and is like moving them down my back. I fucking shit bricks, slam the window closed and fall backwards trying to get him off of me. 

At this point I'm messaging one of my mates asking them if they can pick me up. Earliest that they could get me was 30 minutes so I made up some half assed excuse to my mate that I had work tomorrow. I didn't want to piss him off and I was scared he wouldn't believe me. 

Nothing else happens. My lift arrives and I get the fuck out of there as fast as I can. I say goodbye, tell him I'll come around again some time and get in the car. 

I was crying the moment we turned around the corner. Just something about the vibe in that room and how he was looking at me and how he had fucking touched me without asking and how I felt like I could do nothing about it; I can't stop thinking about what might have happened to me if I hadn't had been able to get a lift home and had stayed the night.

Nothing like this has ever happened to me before, and I just wanted to get it all out there rather than bottle it up.   


Am I over-exaggerating?   
Does this sound like nothing at all?

Abuse.title: Was this sexual harassment? I don’t want to call it something it’s not
Abuse.body: A few months back, a guy friend of mine texted me. I could tell he liked me but the feeling was not mutual so whenever I saw him, I made it abundantly clear that I really liked/was speaking to another guy (who we both know.) Anyway, he texted me and told me he was ‘touch starved’ and proceeded to say ‘i’m not going to ask you for sex because you’re probably saving yourself for X (the guy I liked), but if you want to platonically make out that would be great’ Upon receiving these texts I was completely baffled as i’d made it clear I was into another guy. I rejected him and told him things had progressed between me and the guy and we were now sleeping together (I genuinely don’t understand how he could POSSIBLY think i’d say yes). He then replied with something along the lines of ‘No problem, but the fact you managed to pull X is impressive.’ This annoyed me as he implied I was punching above my weight. I saw him a few weeks after he texted me and he was awkward around me for the entire night, sheepishly saying ‘sorry for asking you to shag me’ (implying that he did want to do more than make out) when we were alone together. He was awkward around me in school (we were in the same friend group.) A few months after the text, our friend group were all out together to get drunk in a field (socially distanced). We were walking in twos bc of covid restrictions and I ended up getting stuck walking with him. He was on the side of the pavement closest to the road whilst I was on his other side. At one point he said ‘you’re too drunk you’re going to fall into the road’ and tried to put his arm around me. I was completely sober and was not about to do that (I wasn’t even near the road). I pushed him off and told him to get off me, as I felt incredibly uncomfortable around him at this point. I ended up leaving early because he kept sitting too close to me. I thought we were on okay terms, but he unfollowed me on social media today. Here is my question- does this count as sexual harassment? I only ask as one of my friends was talking about him (I told her what happened) and said that he sexually harassed me. But I don’t know if it necessarily is harassment. He certainly made me feel uncomfortable both times, but when he texted me but he didn’t make any attempt to try and persuade me to say yes after I rejected him. In regards to him trying to put his arm around me, this could have been seen as just a friendly gesture, but it made me uncomfortable because he knew I’m still romantically involved with X and I wasn’t even drunk. But then again, does trying to put your arm around someone count? I’m still hurt at the fact he tried to make our friendship sexual, as he was a good friend to me for a while. So- was this a case of sexual harassment or merely me putting him deep in the friendzoned?

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Mental Health.title: Was this sexual harassment? I don’t want to call it something it’s not
Mental Health.body: A few months back, a guy friend of mine texted me. I could tell he liked me but the feeling was not mutual so whenever I saw him, I made it abundantly clear that I really liked/was speaking to another guy (who we both know.) Anyway, he texted me and told me he was ‘touch starved’ and proceeded to say ‘i’m not going to ask you for sex because you’re probably saving yourself for X (the guy I liked), but if you want to platonically make out that would be great’ Upon receiving these texts I was completely baffled as i’d made it clear I was into another guy. I rejected him and told him things had progressed between me and the guy and we were now sleeping together (I genuinely don’t understand how he could POSSIBLY think i’d say yes). He then replied with something along the lines of ‘No problem, but the fact you managed to pull X is impressive.’ This annoyed me as he implied I was punching above my weight. I saw him a few weeks after he texted me and he was awkward around me for the entire night, sheepishly saying ‘sorry for asking you to shag me’ (implying that he did want to do more than make out) when we were alone together. He was awkward around me in school (we were in the same friend group.) A few months after the text, our friend group were all out together to get drunk in a field (socially distanced). We were walking in twos bc of covid restrictions and I ended up getting stuck walking with him. He was on the side of the pavement closest to the road whilst I was on his other side. At one point he said ‘you’re too drunk you’re going to fall into the road’ and tried to put his arm around me. I was completely sober and was not about to do that (I wasn’t even near the road). I pushed him off and told him to get off me, as I felt incredibly uncomfortable around him at this point. I ended up leaving early because he kept sitting too close to me. I thought we were on okay terms, but he unfollowed me on social media today. Here is my question- does this count as sexual harassment? I only ask as one of my friends was talking about him (I told her what happened) and said that he sexually harassed me. But I don’t know if it necessarily is harassment. He certainly made me feel uncomfortable both times, but when he texted me but he didn’t make any attempt to try and persuade me to say yes after I rejected him. In regards to him trying to put his arm around me, this could have been seen as just a friendly gesture, but it made me uncomfortable because he knew I’m still romantically involved with X and I wasn’t even drunk. But then again, does trying to put your arm around someone count? I’m still hurt at the fact he tried to make our friendship sexual, as he was a good friend to me for a while. So- was this a case of sexual harassment or merely me putting him deep in the friendzoned?

Mental Health.title: I'm scared I scarred my friend
Mental Health.body:
Hey everyone, my friend is having a real hard time with the last thing that happened between us, and its literally killing me.

So for context, me and this friend knew each other for 6 years, we'd always get high together and chill. So about 2 days ago, we were on G and I asked him if he wanted to make out and he said sure. We made out and then proceeded back to our friend group. Later on, I asked if he wanted to make out again and he said sure, so we got things going, at one point I asked him what do you want me to do? and I asked him if we should stop, he said no he doesnt mind it and that liked it. So we kept going. However, my friend told me yesterday that the guy is struggling with what happened, he said he couldnt say no to me because he was afraid that if he rejected me, that would cause me to stop talking to him and cut him off from my life. 

He said that he felt pressured to say yes to me, even though I asked several times and he said he liked it. I feel very confused as why he would say yes (keep in mind, I dont make out with people normally) if he didnt want to make out? It breaks my heart to see the amount of pain he is in, I feel like such a monster right now, even though I asked him a lot. 

I really don't know how to feel about this, I thought it was ok since I asked him several times and he said he liked it, but now I hear from a mutual that he's crying and is very troubled about the whole situation. 

How can I fix this? I dont want to invalidate his emotions the guy is obviously going through a hard time, Im just so confused because he said yes several times, and now I feel so ashamed and guilty for not knowing better. 

This is the first time I ever go through something like this, I never imagined I could cause this much pain and its been in my head all day. Can you guys tell me what you think of the whole situation?

Discrimination.title: Legal Action Advice
Discrimination.body:
About three/four weeks ago I went through an incident of sexual harassment/assault at work from a customer. He was black out drunk (I work at a pub) and the way it was handled by my work wasn’t very professional. He was kicked out and told he wasn’t allowed to come back in to pay his tab without talking to my boss or my male coworker first since I made it clear I did not want to have contact with him. 

Well my boss allowed him to come into work yesterday without informing me. And not just to pay his tab, he was allowed to stay and drink. Thankfully I had someone else covering the opening part of my shift but was planning on coming in earlier to help with the bar since there was an event so I knew the restaurant was super busy. I was notified by my male coworker that he showed up so I had to wait till he was gone to come in for my shift. 

One of my regulars is a state trooper and he pulled me aside to tell me that from a professional view, I could take it further if the incident made me this uncomfortable (he wasn’t informed much on what happened). I didn’t have intent to pursue anything legal cause I thought he’d be barred on the days i work, but now I’m not sure what I want to do. 

The statie told me that the guy admits he doesn’t remember what happened but takes full accountability for it and that he wants to apologize to me in person but on my terms. My boss also has talked about him coming in to apologize and I’ve expressed very clearly before that I don’t want to talk to him or hear an “I’m sorry for sexually assaulting you” apology, even if he has owned up to what happened. 

I just wanted to not have him in when I’m working or still be there when I’m into work. He’s been very drunk/overserved numerous times before this incident, and now dealing with that, i don’t want to deal with what could happen if he got blacked out drunk again (if he didn’t remember what he did, he could just as well do it again). But now since he’s just allowed back I’m not sure what legal action I could take if i chose to do that. What would be the options I could take? Cause honestly my biggest option is just quitting my job and working at a different place since it’s not the first sexual harassment incident I’ve gone through and it’s definitely not the last, and it’s clear my boss can’t handle dealing with situations properly.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

Now, I realized that those are excuses (but I truly believe that those things need to be fixed as well).

I've never told this story to anyone. I think about my actions every day and deeply regret it. I just needed to get it off my chest and the guilt is constantly eating away at me where I can't even focus on my work. I am not sure what to do.

Medical.title: Super sure before my abortion and now feel horrible
Medical.body:
Hey everyone, throwaway account for obvious reasons.
I had a surgical abortion 6 days ago, I was 9 weeks pregnant.
I’m almost 32 and have been with my boyfriend for 1.5 years. 
When I found out I was pregnant I immediately knew I wanted an abortion, there were no warm feelings towards the fetus, I was very annoyed how it was changing and messing with my body already,  my boobs went a cup bigger and the nausea was incapacitating. 
Aside from the physical symptoms I am not really ready to have a child right now, I’ve been out of work for 8 months and am only starting a new job next month, my boyfriend and I don’t really live in the same city, he currently doesn’t even have a permanent home of his own because he recently finished his camper van and has been bouncing between my city, the Canary Islands, his hometown and the city he last lived permanently. I think partly because of this back and forth our relationship has had its rocky patches.
We had also talked about it before and both agreed that we’re not ready yet to have kids. I wasn’t even sure I ever wanted kids.

So it was a super easy decision and one we didn’t hesitate to make. In the two weeks leading up to the appointment I was super sure and very calm and went about my life as normally as I could, I went to a festival (took some psychedelics), to a wedding and tried not to let the pregnancy bother me.

Fast forward to the day of the abortion, I went in very calm and collected, was even confused why the clinic staff treated me so kindly and carefully. The doctor even held my hand until I was out from the anaesthetic.

When I woke up I had my first crying spell. My boyfriend picked me up and the first couple of days I was mostly fine aside from the bleeding.

Then everything shifted and I have been going through intense grief, heavy crying spells and anxiety.
I’m worried I made a mistake, that I do truly want a family and that this was my only chance because I’m so old already. I’m also worried my boyfriend will never be ready and I will be left waiting until it’s too late. 
There’s many more intrusive thoughts around those topics but mostly I’m just so so sad.

Has anyone experienced this? And does it pass? Rationally speaking I know that all my reasons for having the abortion were and are still valid, and that there is still plenty of time to have a child, but emotionally I wish I could go back, so I would still have a choice. I don’t know if my decision would end up being different but I feel so awful right now. I want this to stop :(

Edit to add: I’m just so confused because I was so sure and calm and I don’t understand why this is so hard on me right now.

He treats my children as his own and is a great step father. He’s moved us into a new house and it’s allowed me to start learning to cook, grow plants, and have a space I love. I truly don’t want to lose him but I’d like for these issues to calm down but I’m not sure they will. We’ve talked about marriage but I don’t want him to live a miserable life and us regret anything.

Pregnancy.title: I cheated on my wife
Pregnancy.body: I(31m) have been with my wife(28f)for over 11 years, married 4 of those years. I have known her since she was 16/17 she didn’t originally want a relationship with me just a friendship. She was in her own relationships at the time and never had any feelings towards me at the time but since I met her I have had my heart set on her. She wonderful, I love that we have everything in common. I don’t have to filter myself we can talk for hours about everything and nothing at all. She funny. Has the most beautiful smile and laugh I have ever heard. Our sex life is amazing. She has a higher sex drive than me but she never gets mad or frustrated when I can’t keep up with her. She never treated me bad. We even have a baby that’s a clone of her with some of me mix in it. My life with her is amazing. The problem is she found out I have been cheating on her with other people and I have a child with another woman, the thing that gave it away was the STDs I passed on to her, and my mistress exposing herself to my wife. Everything came out last year, my wife found everything going back to the beginning of our relationship, all the text, the dating apps, the OF account, the people I would go see and bring to our home, especially my mistress(22f) I would bring when my wife would go see her family, everyone in my side knew it was a running joke about how I always had someone on standby when my wife was working or sick. It was easy to keep them away from each other the first 2 years. My wife had a episode and was hospitalized, I didn’t want to be alone with the guilt and our baby, my AP was desperate to stay with me she moved herself in while my wife was in recovery and would threaten to hurt herself if I tried to get her to leave. I tried my hardest to have her see my point of view how I was stuck between the love of my life and daughter and my one time mistake. I just wanted her home, I missed her. My AP would drive me to the hospital and my in-laws so I could see my wife, and I would go early to the hospital and stay til visiting hours ended then I would cry on AP’s shoulder how much I wanted my wife back on the drives home. I fought with my in-laws to have my wife back home, they tried to take my daughter per my wife request and I lost it, I was scared I was going to loose everything, I begged my wife to give me a second chance and to let us fix us. But I didn’t want to tell her that AP refused to leave, I couldn’t leave my wife alone but I didn’t care I love her. I took care of her and our baby, I fed, medicated, and clothed her, while AP sat and slept in our living room, I didn’t want to end things with both I know AP was crazy and I knew my wife would never give me another chance so I would lie every time they would separately talk to me, then one day it boiled over and my wife got police to remove AP and got a RO. The whole time AP would threaten to take me to court or some other bs but she was always begging for sex and it was easy for me since my wife stopped being intimate with me, especially when she found out she was pregnant during her hospitalization. She tried to leave me the whole year and wouldn’t go through with it, she would tell me to move out  because she deserved our apartment but would never leave herself. I had no where to go my AP didn’t want me there she was seeing another man, and we’re only hooking up during visitations, I got both of them pregnant at the same time every single time, Call me a pos but I would purposefully make AP stress out each pregnancy I didn’t want more kids with her and besides she had other men come over to see her who really knew if it was my kid, I would only see her weekends for “my son”. Every time my wife was pregnant I’ll make sure AP knew it would make her crash out in the most pathetic ways, especially when my family would tell her at family functions. I just didn’t expect AP to harass my wife and tamper with her medicine when we stopped by for me to see my son. My wife completely shut down, once she figured out what she did and that it was linked to her miscarriage. She couldn’t press charges because I allowed her on the premises she got multiple RO on her but she never had enough evidence. So she got mean and cold to me, every time I tried to love her and spoil her she would throw it in my face I wasn’t good enough, or to take to my “bitches” it would get annoying i wanted my old wife with her and she didn’t want me, she stopped going our with me she stopped talking to me unless it was for our daughter and it hurt to loose her slowly like that, i would vent to my AP about it. The worst was one fight where she told me “she settled with me just to hurt the both of us (me &AP). I wouldn’t leave her and won’t let AP know I didn’t want her and AP couldn’t become his legal wife, and that her withholding details to her family made her look stupid because they all knew who I was at this point. That as long as she stayed with me, posted us as a happy family together for AP to see my little trips will always be misery because his whole family knew everything because my AP wouldn’t stop talking to my nosy family and it made me the bigger joke that I already was” My sweet beautiful wife had turned venomous, and I hated how she would look at me with hate, even when we did sleep together she made me feel inadequate and used, she stopped telling me she loved me. She would always be on her phone, I wouldn’t go through it in her sleep and couldn’t find anything but I had a gut feeling and every argument about it would turn to her laughing at me calling pathetic and insecure, that ‘she would never stoop that low as me, that she knew I was still cheating and that if I thought I was slick I was actually stupid. That her phone will always be clean because she knows how to out do a cheater if she tried” she’ll just say things to bring in doubt and cause me to overthink. I never truly stopped until this Valentine’s Day, everything was perfect she was starting to love me again but that night she found everything I never stopped, and she got physical with me, I tried to stop her my brother tried to instead I ended up too injured and scared, but I stayed even after telling g her if she hit me I would leave. She hit me twice that day telling me to leave like the dog I am. I didn’t. I wanted her. It’s been months and we are back I therapy she won’t forgive me or forget what I did, everyday is jab after jab. Or a fight and confrontation with new stuff I forgot to delete. I tried my hardest to make her feel I’m trying but she won’t see it, everyday session she tells them she doesn’t want to be with me, that she’s only with me because of our baby and financial support, but even then I struggle to bring in rent. I found all her applications for studios and messages with her friend, she told me she wants to leave after our daughter’s birthday and it hurts. She tells me therapy is the only way she can try to be with me enough to co parent, I lost my son for our family. No one wants to house me. I don’t have a job steady enough to live by myself, I hate myself I hate she’s leaving me. When she does walk away from me I grab her and refuse to let her leave. I’m so scared to loose her, why doesn’t she want to forgive me. I forgive her for being mean and toxic this past year

Pregnancy.title: My [25f] best friend [25f] knew my husband was cheating on me and didn’t tell me. Saying she didn’t want to hurt me?
Pregnancy.body:
So, like the title said I very unfortunately found out about a month and a half ago my husband [28m] cheated on me. I know for a fact about 3 times, but I have to assume there was more. It was all with the same woman, I think she's 31 or 32 & they work together. She was a guest at our wedding 🫠

He cheated on me while I was doing IVF.. I had 3 miscarriages 1 before and 2 right after we were married. And my point in including that is i literally cried and cried to my best friend, she encouraged me to keep going and have faith. And aside from the fact she saw how much I was struggling, and crying to her because I knew how badly he wanted to be a dad.. I'm really hurt she was going to let me get pregnant knowing I was being cheated on.

Her husband also knew, he's pretty good friends with mine.

She also comforted me right after I found out, at that point I only knew about one occasion because I walked into it. 

I found out recently she knew about him cheating before our wedding... she found out the very first time he did it, let me marry him. Was my maid of honour 

If you're wondering, the way I found out was my (ex) husband came to our house. He moved out, but came back to apologize and promised to tell me everything and gave me his phone for proof. He told me who all knew, two of his friends and her. 

I saw texts between them.

There was a very odd conversation that made my stomach turn where he texted her saying he needed someone to talk to, because he "f*cked up again" and she was oddly sympathetic towards him


I will say, she was defending me to an extent in the rest of the conversations and arguing with him. But regardless, I wouldn't let her marry someone or have babies with them if I knew about cheating.

I'll never forgive him, but I'm really trying to see this from her perspective. I'm hurt, but we have been friends for 14 years... she said she wanted me to be happy and she thought he was changing. She also told me we should try couples therapy.. despite the fact I have said I'm done. 

There was literally never one sign from her, she never voiced any concern about our relationship and anytime I talked about him she went on about how much he loved me, how lucky I was etc. 

Also, we were raised religious. All of us, and she keeps guilting me that divorce is not okay.. yet wants me to forgive cheating?
